About Us

Manpower you can put on duty with confidence

GSL Security Services is a security and manpower service provider established in 2009, with its head office in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra, and branches in Mumbai, Pune and Goa. Over the years we have supplied trained, verified personnel to businesses, housing societies, event organisers and worksites — every deployment is briefed, uniformed where required, and supervised closely from our head office.

Mission
